title: Counter increment loop
statement: For a label $e$ and a phase $j\in\{0,1,2\}$, define a register instruction as follows: at phase $0$, branch on whether register $r_c$ is zero, going to $e$ if it is and to phase $1$ otherwise; at phase $1$, decrement $r_c$ and go to phase $2$; at phase $2$, increment $r_{c_1}$ and return to phase $0$.
